thread:
talia: Quick bug from a trial user: starterkit in jsonMode + fn-call fails after token refresh. Posting short repro and capture.
aj: paste the capture?
talia: network dump shows function_call.arguments comes back quoted as a JSON string after retry: `{"type":"function_call","name":"log_event","arguments":"{\"event\":\"signup\",\"user_id\":\"u42\"}"}` — should be an object.
maria: likely double-serialize during auth-retry. JS transport appears to stringify again when resending. Python didn't hit it in our tests.
aj: I can reproduce by forcing a 401 and letting auto-refresh run. Local quickfix: set req._serialized = true before retry to avoid second stringify (ugly).
samir: can we add a short-term SDK guard: skip JSON.stringify if body is already a string or flagged? Also add an integration test that simulates refresh and asserts arguments remains an object.
aj: plan: will open a small PR with transport guard + test.
maria: devex note: make starterkit validator tolerant in dev mode (lenient coercion) and show a clearer error message that suggests auth/retry serialization as a root cause.
talia: adding a troubleshooting blurb in starterkit README so new users can self-fix: "If you see arguments as a quoted JSON string after refresh, update to SDK patch or pin refresh during onboarding."
dev-bot: created PR #4392: transport-serialize-guard (CI pending).
aj: will iterate on failed CI if it reproduces.
